mapper.select: SELECT C.*, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME, (SELECT CATE_VALUE FROM CATEGORY WHERE CATE_SEQ = C.COURSE_CATEGORY) AS CATE_VALUE, COALESCE(AVG(R.REVIEW_RATE), 0.0) AS AVG_RATING, COUNT(R.REVIEW_SEQ) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM COURSE C JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = C.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN COURSE_REVIEW R ON R.COURSE_SEQ = C.COURSE_SEQ AND R.REVIEW_DELETE_TIME IS NULL GROUP BY C.COURSE_SEQ, C.COURSE_TITLE, C.COURSE_CONTENT, C.COURSE_CATEGORY, C.COURSE_DIFFICULT, C.COURSE_PRICE, C.COURSE_DISCOUNT, C.COURSE_THUMBNAIL, C.COURSE_TARGET, C.COURSE_PREPARATION, C.COURSE_EXPOSE, C.COURSE_CONFIRM_TIME, C.COURSE_CREATE_TIME, C.MEMBER_NO, C.COURSE_TYPE, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME

SELECT C.COURSE_SEQ, C.COURSE_TITLE, C.COURSE_CONTENT, C.COURSE_CATEGORY, C.COURSE_DIFFICULT, C.COURSE_PRICE, C.COURSE_DISCOUNT, C.COURSE_THUMBNAIL, C.COURSE_TARGET, C.COURSE_PREPARATION, C.COURSE_EXPOSE, C.COURSE_CONFIRM_TIME, C.COURSE_CREATE_TIME, C.MEMBER_NO, C.COURSE_TYPE, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME, (SELECT CATE_VALUE FROM CATEGORY WHERE CATE_SEQ = C.COURSE_CATEGORY) AS CATE_VALUE, CRC.CONFIG_ID, CRC.OPEN_DATE_TIME, CRC.MAX_CONCURRENT_USERS, CRC.WAITING_ROOM_OPEN_MINUTES, CRC.IS_ACTIVE, CRC.CREATED_AT, CRC.UPDATED_AT FROM COURSE C JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = C.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN COURSE_RESERVATION_CONFIG CRC ON C.COURSE_SEQ = CRC.COURSE_SEQ WHERE C.COURSE_TYPE = 'EVENT' AND (CRC.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' OR CRC.IS_ACTIVE IS NULL) ORDER BY CRC.OPEN_DATE_TIME ASC

SELECT C.*, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME, (SELECT CATE_VALUE FROM CATEGORY WHERE CATE_SEQ = C.COURSE_CATEGORY) AS CATE_VALUE, COALESCE(AVG(R.REVIEW_RATE), 0.0) AS AVG_RATING, COUNT(R.REVIEW_SEQ) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM COURSE C JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = C.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN COURSE_REVIEW R ON R.COURSE_SEQ = C.COURSE_SEQ AND R.REVIEW_DELETE_TIME IS NULL WHERE C.COURSE_TYPE = 'EVENT' GROUP BY C.COURSE_SEQ, C.COURSE_TITLE, C.COURSE_CONTENT, C.COURSE_CATEGORY, C.COURSE_DIFFICULT, C.COURSE_PRICE, C.COURSE_DISCOUNT, C.COURSE_THUMBNAIL, C.COURSE_TARGET, C.COURSE_PREPARATION, C.COURSE_EXPOSE, C.COURSE_CONFIRM_TIME, C.COURSE_CREATE_TIME, C.MEMBER_NO, C.COURSE_TYPE, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME

SELECT C.*, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME, (SELECT CATE_VALUE FROM CATEGORY WHERE CATE_SEQ = C.COURSE_CATEGORY) AS CATE_VALUE, COALESCE(AVG(R.REVIEW_RATE), 0.0) AS AVG_RATING, COUNT(R.REVIEW_SEQ) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM COURSE C JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = C.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN COURSE_REVIEW R ON R.COURSE_SEQ = C.COURSE_SEQ AND R.REVIEW_DELETE_TIME IS NULL WHERE 1=1
AND (C.COURSE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR C.COURSE_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR C.COURSE_TARGET LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND C.COURSE_TYPE = #{courseType}
AND C.COURSE_DIFFICULT = #{difficulty}
AND C.COURSE_PRICE = 0
AND C.COURSE_PRICE > 0
GROUP BY C.COURSE_SEQ, C.COURSE_TITLE, C.COURSE_CONTENT, C.COURSE_CATEGORY, C.COURSE_DIFFICULT, C.COURSE_PRICE, C.COURSE_DISCOUNT, C.COURSE_THUMBNAIL, C.COURSE_TARGET, C.COURSE_PREPARATION, C.COURSE_EXPOSE, C.COURSE_CONFIRM_TIME, C.COURSE_CREATE_TIME, C.MEMBER_NO, C.COURSE_TYPE, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME
ORDER BY C.COURSE_PRICE ASC ORDER BY C.COURSE_PRICE DESC ORDER BY AVG_RATING DESC ORDER BY C.COURSE_CREATE_TIME DESC ORDER BY C.COURSE_CREATE_TIME DESC
